_comment: Real file is written to %LOCALAPPDATA%\FAFO\local-paths.json by Setup-SitesDataDirectory / Set-FAFOVerifoneSitesRoot. Never commit the real file with secrets or machine paths you care about keeping private — it is machine-local by design. ExplorerMetaRoot is optional: FAFO Local Tab tagging companion (port 8765). Launch prefs also live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\FAFO\launch-prefs.json.
